risks.risk: Brand and model are unknown; no readable label on panels.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the back label or nameplate showing brand, model, and specifications.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unbranded or unknown generic panel.

risks.risk: Wattage or power output is not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the specification sticker or a video of the panel connected to a charge controller/multimeter under sunlight showing output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unrated panel with unknown output.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of purchase receipt, installation date, or serial number with manufacturer date code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an aged used panel with unknown remaining life.

risks.risk: Panels may not work or may have cracks, delamination, or water damage.
risks.proof: Video of the panel in sunlight connected to a load or charge controller producing power, plus close-up inspection of the glass and frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or faulty.

risks.risk: Mounting brackets, cables, or connectors may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories laid out next to the panels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as panel only, with no accessories included.

risks.risk: Warranty status or remaining warranty is unknown.
risks.proof: Warranty card or screenshot of manufacturer warranty check using the serial number.

Video of each panel in sunlight connected to a charge controller or multimeter showing output.
Photo of any mounting brackets, cables, or connectors included.
